Ultra-Luxury 6-Bedroom Villa | Maldives Cluster | DAMAC Islands

Property Size: 4,844.72 sq. ft
Bedrooms: 6
Location: Maldives Cluster, DAMAC Islands
Developer: DAMAC Properties

Discover resort-style waterfront living in this exquisite 6-bedroom villa nestled within the Maldives Cluster of DAMAC Islands. Offering breathtaking views, elegant architecture, and world-class amenities, this residence embodies the ultimate coastal luxury lifestyle.

Property Features:

Expansive 4,844.72 sq. ft of meticulously designed living space
6 spacious bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms
Open-concept living and dining areas with full-height windows
Modern kitchen with premium finishes and integrated appliances
Private terrace and landscaped garden
Direct access to the lagoon and marina promenade
Maids room, laundry area, and ample storage

Community Highlights:

Crystal-clear man-made lagoons and white-sand beaches
Private marina, water sports, and fine dining options
Luxury retail and entertainment zones
Resort-style pools, spa, and wellness facilities
24-hour security and gated community

Why DAMAC Islands – Maldives Cluster?

Inspired by the beauty of the Maldives, this exclusive enclave offers a tranquil island escape within Dubai — perfect for discerning homeowners seeking privacy, prestige, and panoramic sea views.
